text: Tell me about yourself and what you are looking for in your next role.
Describe a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you resolve it?
Tell me about a mistake you made at work or school and what you learned from it.
Describe a project you are proud of. What was your specific contribution?
How do you prioritize when you have several deadlines at the same time?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a new technology quickly.
Describe a time you mentored someone or helped a teammate grow.
Tell me about a technical decision you pushed back on. What happened?
Explain the difference between a process and a thread.
What happens, step by step, when you type a URL into a browser and press Enter?
How would you debug a bug that only happens in production?
What makes code easy to test? Give an example from your own work.
Explain how Git branching and merging work, and how you handle a merge conflict.
What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
How does the browser render a page, and what causes layout thrashing?
Explain how state management works in a React app and when you would lift state up.
How would you design a REST API for a to-do app? Walk through the endpoints and status codes.
What is a database index, and when can adding one make things slower?
How do you handle offline support and syncing in a mobile app?
What are the main differences between building for iOS and Android?
Explain the difference between a JOIN and a subquery, and when you would use each.
How would you detect and handle missing or duplicate data in a pipeline?
Tell me about a time a service you owned went down. How did you respond?
